tei:div.tei:p: (pha)༄༅// sgrol ma lha bcu bdun ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ༄༅// rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// dngos grub 'byung gnas bla ma dang*// bcom ldan sgrol ma la btud de// de yi sgrub pa'i thabs kyi rim// man ngag ji bzhin 'dir bshad bya// dbang dang gnang ba thob gyur cing*// brtul zhugs ldan pa'i sgrub pa pos// mnyam par gzhag dang thun mtshams kyi// rnal 'byor gnyis la gnas par bya// de'ang stan bde ba la ting nge 'dzin gyi 'dug stangs kyis gnas nas skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa sngon du song nas/ snying gi nang du zla ba la gnas pa'i tām̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang gi sgrib pa sbyangs shing phyir 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor la bla ma gtso mo'i rigs bdag tu bzhugs pa spyan drangs pa la/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥdang*/ na mastā rā bha ga wa ti maṇ+ḍal bh+yaḥs phyag 'tshal nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tā rā bha ga wa tī maṇ+ḍa la zhes pa sngon du 'gro ba'i ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra ne wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ gis mchod nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag bskyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum brjod nas snying ga'i tām̐ las 'od dkar po/

sngon po/ dmar po/ ljang gu rnams rim pa bzhin 'phros nas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad gang bas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan pa dang*/ sdug bsngal dang 'bral ba dang*/ bde ba dang mi 'bral ba dang*/ phan tshun snyoms pa'i yid dang ldan par bsgoms nas/ oṃ badz+ra muḥs tshogs kyi zhing gshegs su gsol ba ni bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// de nas oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas bdag dang snang ba thams cad stong par bsgoms pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang sngo ba lte ba ljang gu la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur/ bla re/ bkal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ bam̐ las chu/ lam̐ las sa/ sum̐ las ri'i rgyal po ri rab kyi steng du pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i dbus su hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bh+rūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi phyi nas rim pa bzhin/ sngon po/ dmar po/ ser po/ dkar po/ ljang gu'i rtsig pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser po la drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyangs pa de'i steng du mda' yab kyis yongs su bskor ba/ phyi 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la lha mo bcu drug gis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas mchod par byed pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan zhing rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bris nas mdzes par phub pa'i steng du rin po che dang bcas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i tog gis mtshan pa/ sgo yi thad so bzhir rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i steng nas pad+ma dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ gdugs dang ri dwags dang bcas shing*/

gzhan yang zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang*/ rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can dang*/ me tog gi phreng ba dang*/ me long dang*/ gos dang*/ 'phan la sogs pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis spras pa dang ldan zhing sgrib pa med pa'i phyi rol gyi mu khyud la/ phyogs skyong ba bcu dang*/ rgyal po chen po bzhi 'dud pa dang bcas pas yongs su bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang pa'i nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang sngo ba'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams dang grwa bzhir zla ba'i gdan dang*/ sgo bzhir nyi ma'i gdan bsam mo// de nas gdan dbus ma'i steng du/ tām̐ las ut+pa la tām̐ gis mtshan pa'i snying po la āḥlas sna tshogs rdo rje āḥs mtshan pa las 'od zer phar 'phros sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus gcig tu 'dres pa las rang nyid sgrol ma ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pas ut+pa las mtshan pa'i gri gug dang*/ g.yon pas bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa'i phyag dang zhabs gnyis pad+ma'i skyil krung gis yab la 'khyud pa/ de'i pang na bcom ldan 'das don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang shin tu mdzes shing rab tu zhi ba rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o// shar phyogs su oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa las rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po g.yas pas 'khor lo dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ lhor trām̐ las rin po che trām̐ gis mtshan pa las rin chen 'byung ldan ser po g.yas rin po che dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ nub phyogs su hrīḥlas pad+ma hrīḥs mtshan pa las 'od dpag med dmar po g.yas pad+ma dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ byang phyogs su hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las mi bskyod pa sngon po g.yas rdo rje dang*/

g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ shar lhor lam̐ las 'khor lo'i lte bar mig 'bras dang*/ lam̐ gyis mtshan pa las spyan ma dkar mo g.yas 'khor los mtshan pa'i gri gug dang*/ g.yon pas thod pa 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu tām̐ las rin po che tām̐ gis mtshan pa las rin chen sgrol ma ser mo g.yas rin po ches yu ba byas pa'i gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ nub byang du pam̐ las pad+ma pam̐ gyis mtshan pa las/ gos dkar mo dmar mo/ g.yas pad+mas mtshan pa'i gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang shar du mam̐ las rdo rje mam̐ gyis mtshan pa las mā ma kī sngon mo/ g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ phyi'i shar lho'i grwar hūm̐ las spos khang hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las bdug spos ma dkar mo phyag gnyis kyis bdug spos 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu trām̐ las me tog trām̐ gis mtshan pa las me tog ma ser mo phyag gnyis kyis me tog 'dzin pa/ nub byang du hrīḥlas mar me hrīḥs mtshan pa las mar me ma dmar mo phyag gnyis kyis mar me 'dzin pa/ byang shar du aḥlas dri'i dung chos aḥs mtshan pa las dri ma ljang gu phyag gnyis kyis dri bzang po'i chus gang ba'i dung chos 'dzin pa/ de thams cad rab tu zhi zhing mdzes pa rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o// shar sgor dzaḥlas lcags kyu dzaḥs mtshan pa las lcags kyu ma sngon mo rta'i gdong pa can/ phyag gnyis kyis lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ lho sgor hūm̐ las zhags pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las zhags pa ma ser mo phag gdong ma phyag gnyis kyis zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nub sgor bam̐ las lcags sgrog bam̐ gyis mtshan pa las lcags sgrog ma dmar mo khyi'i gdong pa can phyag gnyis kyis lcags sgrog 'dzin pa/ byang sgor hoḥlas dril bu hoḥs mtshan pa las dril bu ma dkar mo dred kyi gdong pa can phyag gnyis kyis dril bu 'dzin pa/ sgo ma bzhi ni khro mo'i cha lugs can/

stag dang sbrul gyis brgyan cing*/ g.yon brkyang ba'i tshul gyis bzhengs pa'o// de dag so so'i thugs kar so so'i sa bon bsams pa las 'od 'phros pas/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang*/ bcud thams cad sgrol ma'i lha tshogs su 'gyur par bsam mo// de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par āḥlas pad+ma dmar po āḥs mtshan pa/ snying gar hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi snying gi nang gi tāṃ las 'od zer phyir 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rang gis bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba spyan drangs pa la snga ma ltar mchod nas/ rang gi snying ga nas spros pa'i lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu ma rnams spros pas ye shes pa rnams dgug pa dang*/ gzhug pa dang bcing ba dang*/ dbang du bya bar bsams nas so so'i phyag rgya bcings la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tā rā bha ga wa tī sa pa ri wā ra/ zhes kun la sbyar la/ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ zhes brjod pas ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa gnyis su med par bya'o// de nas yang snying ga'i tāṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo dang*/ mchod pa'i lha mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs pa la snga ma ltar mchod nas/ oṃ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/

yum rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa mdzad/ dbang gi chu rgyun des rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso mo la don yod grub pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga la rdo rje sems dpa'/ spyan dang*/ bdug pa ma dang*/ lcags kyu ma la rnam par snang mdzad/ rin chen sgrol ma me tog ma/ zhags pa ma la rin chen 'byung ldan/ gos dkar mo mar me ma/ lcags sgrog ma la 'od dpag med/ mā ma kī la mi bskyod pa/ dri ma dang dril bu ma la don yod grub pas dbur brgyan par bsams nas/ dbang gi lha gshegs su gsol la/ lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la yid mnyam par gzhag go /bskyed pa'i rim pa'o// //de nas rang gi snying ga'i tām̐ las 'od 'phros pas phyi rol snod bcud dang*/ 'khor 'das thams cad gsal bar byas nas/ 'od tshur bsdus pa'i zhar la/ de thams cad gzhal yas khang la bsdu/ gzhal yas khang lha rnams dang*/ lha rnams don yod grub pa dang*/ de'ang rang la bsdus nas/ rang nyid kyang thugs ka'i tām̐ la bsdus nas/ tām̐ yang zla tshes dang*/ zla tshes thig le/ thig le nā da/ nā da yang mi dmigs par bsams la stong pa nyid kyi ngang la yid mnyam par gzhag go /rdzogs pa'i rim pa ste mnyam par gzhag pa'i rnal 'byor ro// //de nas skad cig gis rang gtso mo'i skur bzhengs pa'i thugs ka'i tām̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ snod bcud snga ma ltar gsal btab nas/ so so'i thugs ka'i sa bon la sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba'i 'od kyis lha rnams kyi rgyud bskul nas bdag byin gyis brlabs/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs thams cad rgyas par bsams la/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ oṃ a mo gha sid+dhiḥ.aḥswā hā/

oṃ bai ro tsa na oṃ swā hā/ oṃ rat+na saṃ bha wa trāṃ swā hā/ oṃ a mi tā bha wa hrīḥswā hā/ oṃ ak+ṣo bh+ya hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ lo tsa ni laṃ swā hā/ oṃ rat+na tā re tāṃ swā hā/ oṃ paṇ+ḍa ra ba si ni paṃ swā hā/ oṃ mā ma kī maṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe trāṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dī pe hrīḥswā hā/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe aḥswā hā/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥswā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥswā hā/ zhes re re la ci nus pa bzla ba ni bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ro// gtor ma gnyis mngon par 'du byas pa'i dang po a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ āḥlas thod pa'i nang du go ku/ da/ ha/ na las sha lnga dang*/ bi/ mu/ shu/ ma/ ra las bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ oṃ/ hūm̐/ trām̐/ hrīḥ aḥlas ye shes lnga dang*/ de'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje aḥs mtshan par bsams nas/ a las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung g.yos pas me sbar te/ sha lnga dang*/ bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ ye shes lnga bzhu ba'i rlangs pa sna tshogs rdo rje la phog pas lte ba'i a las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs shing*/ slar yang sna tshogs rdo rje'i 'od dang rlangs pa phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs pa sna tshogs rdo rje dang lhan cig thod pa'i nang du lhung bas/ kha dog dang*/ dri dang*/ ro dang*/ bcud phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi byin gyis brlab bo// de nas mdun du rang gis bsgoms pa lta bu'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo skad cig gis bltas te/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'phros pa'i 'od kyis spyan drangs pa'i ye shes pa dang*/ gnyis su med par byas pa'i lha rnams kyi zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung bas gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/

rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re/ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ā d+ya nut+pan+na twā ta/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa so so la'ang sbyar ba gsum la sogs pa brjod pas phul nas/ slar yang mchod cing bstod la 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab bo/ gtor ma gnyis pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor bskyed cing byin gyis brlabs la/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi khor yug tu gnas pa'i phyogs skyong ba dang*/ rgyal po chen po bzhi la dbul bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ in+d+rā ya/ ag+na ye/ ya mā ya/ nair ṛ t+yā ya/ ba ru ṇā ya/ wā ya we/ ku be rā ya/ ī sha nā ya/ brah+ma ṇā ya/ pṛ th+wī de w+yai/ dhṛṣ+ṭa rāṣ+ṭā ya/ bi ru ṭa ka ye/ bi ru pak+ṣā ya/ bai shra wa ṇā ya/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ uṅga te s+pha ra ṇa/ i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ grih+ne daṃ ba liṃ te swā hā/ zhes gsum gyis phul la/ slar yang mchod cing bstod nas gsol ba btab la/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngos nas/ 'das pa dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i mgron gnyis ka la bzod par gsol la gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu'o// gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ro// //kha zas yi ge gsum gyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs nas rang sgrol mar dmigs pa'i lte bar gtum mo'i me 'bar ba'i khrod na/ snying gar dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs gsal bar dmigs pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba dang*/ lto bar phyogs skyong ba bcu dang*/ rgyal po chen po bzhi la 'jig rten pa thams cad kyis bskor ba dmigs nas/ lag pa gnyis dgang blugs kyis kha hoṃ khung du bsreg blugs byas pas mnyes par bsam zhing bza'o// kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ro// //de nas spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe/ lha rnams bsdus nas rang sgrol ma 'ba' zhig tu gnas pa'i sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs la/

oṃ zhes brjod pas bdag gi lus dang snang ba thams cad lha/ āḥzhes brjod pas rang gi ngag tu brjod pa dang*/ grags pa thams cad sngags/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas rtog pa'i 'du 'phro thams cad ye shes kyi cho 'phrul du byin gyis brlabs nas/ phyi rol gyi 'dod yon lngas nang gi lha rnams la mchod par bsam zhing yul rnams la sdang ba dang zhen pa med par spyod pa spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ro// //nyal ba'i tshe lha rnams snga ma ltar bsdus nas chos kyi sku'i ngang la nyal lo// nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ro// //ldang ba'i tshe sngar bshad pa ltar chos kyi sku las gzugs kyi skur bzhengs pa'i tshul gyis ldang ngo*// ldang ba'i rnal 'byor te thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor drug go/ //de ltar dam tshig dang sdom pa rnam par dag cing*/ rnal 'byor de dag la nan tan du byas pas ting nge 'dzin dam pa skyes pa'i tshe/ ji skad bshad pa'i spyod pa dag la nye bar spyad pas ji ltar bsams pa bzhin 'grub pa'i thun mong gi dngos grub dag gis rang dang gzhan gyi yid dga' bar byas nas/ sa dang lam thams cad bde blag tu bgrod de/ dbang phyug brgyad kyis phun sum tshogs pa rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang myur du thob par 'gyur ba nyid do// 'di'i brgyud pa'i rim pa ni/ rje btsun sgrol ma nyi ma sbas pa dpal// tsan+d+ra gar+bha dgra las rgyal ba'i zhabs// ngag dbang grags pa dad byed go cha dpal// de bzhin gshegs pa'i srung ba dang*// dā na shrī dang gzhan yang mañdzu shrī// skad gnyis smra ba blo gros grags pa dang*// bu tser lo tsā dbang phyug rin chen dpal// chos kyi seng ge blo gros brtan pa'i zhabs// de dag las brgyud rdo rje slob dpon ni// nam mkha' grags las thob pa 'phags pa'o// de la go go can gyis gsol btab nas// sgrub thabs rab tu gsal ba 'di sbyar ro// dge bas 'gro kun sgrol mas rjes gzung ste// sgrol ma ji ltar dges pa'i tshul spyad nas// kun kyang bcom ldan sgrol ma nyid gyur te// sgrol ma'i dpal gyis rnam par rol par shog

/phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig gi rjes su 'brang ba'i sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs/ mchims pa'i bla ma gong ma dag gis mdzad pa cung zad mi gsal zhing ma rdzogs par gnas pa las/ gsal zhing rdzogs pa 'di ni gsol ba 'debs pa mang po'i don du chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa'i dge slong sngags 'chang ba 'phags pas/ lcags mo lug gi lo rgyal gyi zla ba'i tshes nyi shu bdun gyi nyin par shing kun mkhar du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni a tsa ra'o/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
